sources.entry: xib2Storyboard - Tool to convert Xcode .xib to .storyboard files.

summary.one_liner: A macOS app that converts Xcode .xib view-controller files into .storyboard files while keeping outlets, constraints, and other objects intact.
summary.what_it_does: xib2Storyboard takes one or more .xib files added through a '+' button or drag-and-drop and exports them as .storyboard files chosen from a dropdown of export options. It states that it preserves outlets, outlet collections, and constraints, and keeps other objects such as additional views and gesture recognizers. It also adds prototype cells to UITableViews. The generated .storyboard files are then imported into an Xcode project. The README says the tool was built by comparing Interface Builder XML formats. Planned features for version 1.0.0 include handling macOS Interface Builder files, splitting a .storyboard into multiple storyboards, and converting a .storyboard to .xib files.
use_cases: migrate interface builder files to storyboards
keep outlets and constraints when converting xib
add prototype cells to table views in a storyboard
how_to_run: Run the xib2Storyboard.app file (the latest release).
Alternatively, build and run the Xcode project.
Add view controller .xib file(s) with the '+' button or by dragging them onto the window.
Select an export option from the dropdown menu.
Import the generated .storyboard files into your Xcode project.
stack: Swift or Objective-C (not named in README)
notable: Keeps outlets, outlet collections, and constraints during conversion
Works from a prebuilt app or the Xcode project source
caveats: Beta software, tested internally but not yet used in live products
May break with future Xcode versions if Apple changes the .xib or .storyboard XML format
Tested only with Xcode 8 and Xcode 9 file formats
Requires macOS 10.11 El Capitan or higher
